title: All finite-cylinder fixed-power locality envelope
question: Does the unchanged PAH-OMC-013 root-radius bound give an explicit fixed-power stabilization threshold for every finite-support cylinder, rather than only ell_(0,0)?

fixed_scope.model: Exactly PAH-001, the PAH-OMC-013 full-Q grade-blind cylinder algebra and the OMC-004 two-row strip; no functional, rate, state, carrier, root family, projection or time change.
fixed_scope.support_parameter: For a finite cylinder f, s_f is the largest column of the vertex/link/face coordinates on which its declared generating coordinates depend; s_f=-1 for the constant cylinder.
fixed_scope.root_locality: The frozen OMC-013 root catalog has maximum core-to-support column radius 2 on every finite level n>=2.
fixed_scope.threshold: After k generator applications, the conservative support envelope has maximum column at most s_f+2k. The threshold is N_k(f)=max(2,s_f+2k+1).
fixed_scope.comparison: The original pointwise pullback I_(n,n+1) and the same finite backward generators used by R-493.
fixed_scope.order: Only fixed finite k is considered. No k/n exchange, exponential-series summation, j limit, anchored-n limit, common process or R-512 identification is claimed.
fixed_scope.time: The original external stochastic Markov time remains unchanged.

conditional_statement: If the R-493 one-step identity holds on every recursively enlarged finite-support cylinder class, then for every finite cylinder f, fixed k and n>=N_k(f), L_(n+1)^k I_(n,n+1) f = I_(n,n+1) L_n^k f.

finite_checks.radius_levels: The primary lane derives radius 2 from the OMC-013 catalog at levels 2 through 9.
finite_checks.support_families: The independent lane tests constant, single-vertex, separated-vertex, adjacent-vertex and face-generated support envelopes.
finite_checks.threshold_table: For each support maximum s in {-1,0,1,4,6} and k=0,...,5, the computed threshold separates the support envelope from the successor frontier columns.
finite_checks.R561_relation: The ell_(0,0) row s=0 reproduces N_k=max(2,2k+1) from R-561.
finite_checks.Lean: Lean proves the arithmetic strict-separation inequality and reuses the generic iterate-intertwining induction without asserting a uniform operator bound.

decision_rule.PASS_CONDITIONAL: Use only for the all-finite-cylinder fixed-k locality envelope and its explicit threshold.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Keep PAH-OMC-020 open because a uniform-in-k tail, common realization, N2b/N2c/N4/N2d and R-512 selection are not supplied.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Use only if the frozen radius-two catalog or the threshold separation fails for a declared finite-support family.

missing_assumptions: The R-493 one-step identity must be available for every recursively enlarged cylinder in the envelope, not only for the tested support examples.
A source-authorized uniform-in-k word/factorial tail is still required to sum powers in compact Markov time.
A source-authorized common U_n/path-space realization, N2b liminf/recovery, N2c/N4 boundary escape and N2d R-512 minimal-form identification remain absent.
non_claims: No single N(f) works for all generator powers; the threshold grows with k.
No full exponential semigroup intertwining, anchored-n convergence, common infinite-volume process or R-512 semigroup identification.
No universal comparison-map no-go is proved by this envelope.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang--Mills or TOE conclusion follows.

reproduction.lean: Set-Location verification/lean; lake env lean Tect/PahOmc020UniversalLocality.lean
